children: Healthcare stocks are being shaped by a mix of medical-services demand, reimbursement trends, healthcare utilization and developments in drug research.

Within the sector, managed-care companies remain sensitive to membership growth and medical costs, healthcare-services providers are influenced by patient volumes and operating margins, while biotechnology stocks can see their prospects change sharply with clinical and regulatory developments.

Against this backdrop, a list of healthcare stocks identifies four companies that have maintained a Strong Buy Quant Rating for at least 60 consecutive days. The qualifying names span health care services, managed health care and biotechnology, offering exposure to different parts of the healthcare industry while sharing sustained quantitative strength.
BrightSpring Health Services, Inc.
leads the list, having maintained a Strong Buy Quant Rating for 206 consecutive days. Centene Corporation
follows with 157 consecutive days, while Aveanna Healthcare Holdings Inc.
has retained the rating for 90 days. Q32 Bio Inc.
rounds out the list with 64 consecutive Strong Buy days.

The companies represent distinct healthcare subsectors, from healthcare services and managed care to biotechnology. The varying business models mean their earnings and market drivers can differ considerably, even as each company has maintained the same Strong Buy quantitative designation for at least two months.

Seeking Alpha's Quant Ratings system grades stocks on their relative performance on key quantitative metrics. It hones in on stocks with the strongest combination of value, growth, profitability, EPS revisions and price momentum relative to their sector peers.
